assembly_notes: Wearable badge/ID holder clip standing up and facing -Y. The rigid clip_body is the root; X is the clip width, Z the clip length (mouth at +Z, swivel tail at -Z) and the badge plane is the world XZ plane. clamp_build is one structural family: alligator_yoke, ear_hinge_thumb and bulldog_lever all hang a sprung jaw on a real hinge pin (REVOLUTE about X, barrel tube on the pin with a 0.4 mm running clearance, so the jaw is captured at every angle), while magnet_backer drops the hinge entirely and slides a magnet backer along two headed guide pins (PRISMATIC about Y, travel bounded by the sleeve/pin engagement). grip_build re-dresses whichever pair of clamping faces the active clamp presents; swivel_build changes the mount on the body and the matching hub on the connector; connector_build changes what hangs from the swivel. All four slots combine freely: the clamp publishes its real front envelope, grip station and face gap, and the swivel derives its stand-off from that envelope so the badge plane always clears the clamp at every swivel angle. clamp_stage_count is the number of clamping-force stations across the clip: torsion coil stations on the hinge pin with the jaw barrel split into N+1 segments between them, or magnet pole stations on the backer. clip_length_m, clip_width_m, jaw_open_rad and connector_drop_m are the independent parameters; palette and stamped decoration are non-core.

derived.name: grip_height_m
derived.rationale: the grip rows are sized from the clamp candidate's real face gap, so the hinged mouth and the magnetic sandwich both keep a 0.8 mm bite gap

derived.name: grip_station_z_m
derived.rationale: the grip rows sit on whichever line the active clamp actually pinches

derived.name: swivel_post_len_m
derived.rationale: the mount stands the swivel off far enough that the badge plane clears the clamp: a slim post for the alligator, a tall bridge for the bulldog levers

derived.name: connector_width_m
derived.rationale: the badge panel is about as wide as the clip it hangs from, as in both source straps (002: 24 mm strap on a 30 mm body; 001: 20 mm strap on an 18 mm body), and never narrower than the snap ring bore plus its flange

multiplicities.host_capacity_expression: 1 <= clamp_stage_count <= 3; every station needs 2 * stage_tube + 0.0006 m of pin and every barrel segment between them must stay above 0.0007 m, which the narrowest 0.018 m clip still satisfies at N=3
multiplicities.name: clamp_stage_count
multiplicities.spacing_expression: stations are evenly spaced across the usable pin span, pitch = pin_span_m / (clamp_stage_count + 1); the jaw barrel is split into clamp_stage_count + 1 tube segments in the gaps between them

candidates.evidence: Long slender stamped leaf with two folded side cheeks carrying a through hinge pin and a torsion coil; the sprung jaw's barrel wraps that pin and its front end is folded into a blade over the mouth.

dimensions.radius: barrel bore 0.0022 m on a 0.0018 m pin

candidates.name: alligator_yoke
